note: Curecanti NRA campground on US-50 between mile markers 112 and 113, ~20 mi east of Montrose, at the old narrow-gauge railroad town of Cimarron beside the Cimarron River; the Cimarron Canyon rail exhibit is next door and Crystal Reservoir at Morrow Point Dam is ~1.5 mi away. Rarely fills. No cell service; an emergency 911 phone is by the visitor center door. --Claude
summary: NPS campground record + rec.gov 10104815: confirmed vault toilets, FCFS only, $24. Changed sites.count 22->21 (NPS totalSites 21; rec.gov's 22nd 'site' is the Scan and Pay placeholder), max_rig_ft 35->null (unsourced; NPS says only 'medium sized RVs'). Added potable water (seasonal), season note (typically May-October). Note cleaned of field restatements and the unsourced 35-ft figure; 'Cimarron River canyon below Morrow Point Dam' reworded to the agency's description.
flags: Missing phone: Curecanti NRA (970) 641-2337 (NPS campground record contact; park footer gives ext. 205).
Website: the stored URL is the park-wide camping page; the campground's own page is https://www.nps.gov/cure/planyourvisit/camp_cimarron.htm.

Rig length (informational, not a drop): the NPS says 'tents to medium sized RVs' / 'Medium sized Rvs are allowed', with no length; a 23-ft Class C is medium at most. The NPS API record's trailerAllowed '0' and rvMaxLength '0' look like unfilled defaults, not a trailer ban (no NPS prose says so). Campendium lists 30 ft max; Campendium/Dyrt reviewers report a 33-ft fifth wheel and a 45-ft toy hauler fitting (dates not checked). The old 35-ft figure had no source and was cleared.

Facilities conflict: recreation.gov's description says 'Seasonal potable water, flush toilets, dump station', while the NPS record says vault toilets and dumpStation 'No'. The NPS (operator) was followed; dump left unset. Worth asking the park.

Waterfront check (stored not waterfront, no change): on imagery the Cimarron River runs along the campground's west side, ~30-50 m from the western sites (012, 015, 017, 019, 021). Between them are the paved park road to Morrow Point Dam and a cottonwood riparian band, a developed buffer, so no open apron. riverview at most through the trees; not waterfront is defensible. The campground is on the Cimarron, a tributary ~2.4 km from the Gunnison/Crystal Reservoir.

Status: the only Curecanti alert (toxic algae, Blue Mesa Reservoir) does not concern Cimarron. The recreation.gov 2026 rate window ends Oct 28; a search snippet cites NPS 'open May 4 - October 13, 2026'.
Pin 38.4445,-107.5548 is 48 m from the centroid of the 21 catalogued site points (38.44464,-107.55532), on the campground's east edge near site 005. OK.
